name: axterm production dependency inventory

creationInfo.comment: Reproducible source dependency inventory generated from pnpm licenses list --json --prod plus byte-pinned third-party Cordis framework workspaces.

comment: Scope: installed production dependency graph. This is not an exact platform artifact SBOM, a file-level license inventory, or legal clearance. Electron/Chromium, bundled JavaScript, native binaries, WASM, fonts, copied code and other assets require the artifact-level review recorded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_AUDIT.md.
